bbox._comment: Rough box around Little Jamaica, Toronto: [minLng, minLat, maxLng, maxLat]. Only features overlapping this box are kept when scripts/fetch-open-data.js runs. Widen these numbers to cover more area.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Parking Buildings)
layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Building dataset, filtered down to buildings whose description contains "CARPARK" or is the Toronto Parking Authority's commercial building — grouped under Transportation.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Transit Buildings)
layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Building dataset, filtered down to buildings typed "Subway/LRT Station" (LRT station bike parking, a substation) — grouped under Transportation.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Commercial & Non-Profit Buildings)

Building Description: UNISON HEALTH & COMMUNITY SERVICES - DENTAL CLINIC

layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Building dataset, filtered down to the Nia Centre for the Arts and the Unison Health & Community Services Dental Clinic — grouped under Commercial & Non-Profit Spaces.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Housing Buildings)
layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Building dataset, filtered down to residential buildings (Beech Hall Housing Co-op, and single-family properties at 203 Ava Rd / 222 Strathearn Rd / 567 Arlington Ave) — grouped under Housing.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Public Facility Buildings)

filter.Building Description: YORK CIVIC CENTRE - SILVERTHORN DAY CARE CENTRE

layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Building dataset, filtered down to the Vaughan Road Academy indoor pool, fire halls, police stations, York Civic Centre, the constituency office, community/recreation centres, the York Civic Centre - Silverthorn Day Care Centre, and the former Animal Services building — grouped under Public Facilities. Excludes the Fairbank Memorial Park Community Centre specifically, since its "Community Recreation Centre" type would otherwise also match here — it's already shown by real-estate-park-buildings under Parks & Public Realm, since it sits within Fairbank Memorial Park.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Public Works Buildings)
layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Building dataset, filtered down to the Castlefield Yard / Ingram Yard operations buildings and the fire warehouse & mechanical building — grouped under Transportation.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Park Buildings)

Building Description: FAIRBANK MEMORIAL PARK - OUTDOOR POOL SERVICE BLDG
KEELESDALE PARK - BASEBALL CLUBHOUSE & CHANGE / WASHROOM
CHARLES CACCIA PARK SEWAGE PUMPING STATION

layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Building dataset, filtered down to buildings that sit within named parks already covered by the green-spaces layer (Fairbank Memorial Park, Keelesdale Park, Bert Robinson Park, Charles Caccia Park) — grouped under Parks & Public Realm. Arenas and Community Recreation Centres are handled separately below (real-estate-park-recreation-buildings), since those duplicate entries in the Parks & Recreation Facilities dataset under slightly different names.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Park Arenas & Recreation Centres)
layers._source: Same source file as real-estate-park-buildings, filtered down to the arenas and the community recreation centre — deliberately NOT footprint-matched (unlike the rest of real-estate-park-buildings), so they render as a plain circle instead of tracing the building outline, since these also duplicate entries in Toronto's Parks & Recreation Facilities dataset (Chris Tonks Arena, Phil White Arena, Fairbank Memorial Community Centre) that were removed from Public Facilities in favour of these. Radius 10px — a bit larger than the default 6px circleMarker, since these are bigger facilities than a typical point amenity, but still small enough not to visually compete with the park polygon underneath.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Utility Buildings)
layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Building dataset, filtered down to the Bathurst - Eglinton Meter House (matched by type, which is unique to it) and the Former Hydro Building (matched by exact description, since its "Office Building - Large" type is shared with the constituency office and the Nia Centre for the Arts, both already grouped elsewhere) — grouped under Parks & Public Realm.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Park Land)
layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Land dataset, filtered down to parcels typed "Park/Rec/Open Space" — grouped under Parks & Public Realm.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Walkway Land)
layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Land dataset, filtered down to parcels typed "Walkway" (including the Westview Greenbelt Trail) — grouped under Parks & Public Realm.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Vacant / Held Land)
layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Land dataset, filtered down to parcels typed "Vacant Land", "Reserve Strip", or "Road Allowance" — grouped under Parks & Public Realm.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Utility Land)
layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Land dataset, filtered down to parcels typed "Water Management", plus the Former Hydro Property (matched by exact description, since its "Administrative Faci." type is shared with a carpark parcel already grouped under Transportation) and the York-Weston Meter House — grouped under Parks & Public Realm.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Railway Land)
layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Land dataset, filtered down to parcels typed "Railway Land" (Metrolinx easements) plus the Metrolinx amending agreement parcel — grouped under Parks & Public Realm.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (School Land)

properties.Community Use: Vaughan Road Academy also operates as a City of Toronto community centre (Parks, Forestry & Recreation), including its on-site indoor pool (see the real-estate-public-facility-buildings layer) — listed separately in Toronto's Parks and Recreation Facilities dataset, merged into this record instead of showing a third marker for the same site.

layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Land dataset, filtered down to parcels typed "School" — grouped under Public Facilities. Vaughan Road C.I. doesn't appear in School Locations (schools layer), so its community-centre note lives here rather than there — see that layer's _source note for the equivalent case at St Nicholas of Bari.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Public Facility Land)
layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Land dataset, filtered down to parcels typed "EMS/Fire" or "Police Facility", the Eglinton - Scott Meter House, and the "Commercial/Retail"-typed vacant land at 2475 Eglinton Ave W (matched on both type and description together, since another "Commercial/Retail" parcel — a future carpark — belongs under Transportation instead) — grouped under Public Facilities.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Housing Land)
layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Land dataset, filtered down to parcels typed "Shelter/Housing" (Beech Hall Housing Co-op) or "Residential" — grouped under Housing.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Public Works Land)
layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Land dataset, filtered down to parcels typed "Service Yard" or "Waste Management" (Castlefield Yard, Ingram Yard, Ingram Transfer Station) — grouped under Transportation.

layers.label: Real Estate Asset Inventory (Parking Land)
layers._source: Same source file as the Real Estate Asset Inventory - Land dataset, filtered down to parcels whose description contains "CARPARK" or whose type is "Parking Facility" — grouped under Transportation.

layers.label: Toronto Community Housing
layers._source: City of Toronto Open Data Portal, Toronto Community Housing Data (EPSG:4326). Re-download and replace data/raw/community-housing.geojson to refresh, then re-run scripts/fetch-open-data.js.

layers.label: Supportive Housing
layers._source: City of Toronto Open Data Portal, Supportive Housing (already WGS84 per its .prj — no reprojection needed). Source was a shapefile (.shp/.shx/.dbf/.prj); converted straight to GeoJSON with pyshp. To refresh: re-download the shapefile (all 4 parts) and re-run the same conversion.

layers.label: Places of Worship
layers._source: City of Toronto Open Data Portal, Places of Worship (EPSG:4326). Re-download and replace data/raw/places-of-worship.geojson to refresh, then re-run scripts/fetch-open-data.js.

layers.label: Green Spaces
layers._source: City of Toronto Open Data Portal, Green Spaces (EPSG:4326). Re-download and replace data/raw/green-spaces.geojson to refresh, then re-run scripts/fetch-open-data.js.

layers.label: Parks & Recreation Facilities
layers._source: City of Toronto Open Data Portal, Parks and Recreation Facilities (EPSG:4326), filtered down to parcels typed "Park" — grouped under Parks & Public Realm. The dataset's "Community Centre"/"Civic Centre"-typed entries are dropped entirely: every one of them duplicated a location already shown by a Real Estate Asset Inventory layer, under a slightly different name (see git history around the "York Recreation Centre / York Civic Centre / Arenas" cleanup for the full mapping).

layers.label: Major Transit Station Areas
layers._source: City of Toronto Open Data Portal, Major Transit Station Area Delineations (Jan 2026). Source was a shapefile in NAD27 MTM Zone 10 (no "-4326" GeoJSON export existed) — converted to EPSG:4326 with pyproj and committed directly as GeoJSON (see conversion notes in README.md). To refresh: re-download the shapefile (all 4 parts: .shp/.shx/.dbf/.prj), re-run the same conversion, and replace this file.

properties.Community Use: Also operates as a City of Toronto community centre (Parks, Forestry & Recreation) — listed separately in Toronto's Parks and Recreation Facilities dataset, merged into this one record here to avoid a duplicate marker.

layers._source: City of Toronto Open Data Portal, School Locations (EPSG:4326), excluding private schools (SCHOOL_TYPE_DESC=Private). St Nicholas of Bari Catholic Elementary School gets an added "Community Use" property noting its dual role as a community centre, rather than showing a second marker for it — see real-estate-school-land's _source note for Vaughan Road C.I.'s equivalent case. Re-download and replace data/raw/school-locations.geojson to refresh, then re-run scripts/fetch-open-data.js.

layers.label: Library Branches
layers._source: Toronto Public Library Open Data, Branch General Information (EPSG:4326). Re-download and replace data/raw/library-branches.geojson to refresh, then re-run scripts/fetch-open-data.js.
